facts_of_case: Petitioner seeks transfer of HMA case to the Family Court, Ujjain due to multiple litigations between parties in Ujjain.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer of a case to establish that it is necessary and justifiable.
legal_principles.held: From perusal of the record, it appears that there are so many proceedings pending between both the parties. Some of the cases are pending before Indore.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot use the transfer application as a delaying tactic in a case.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner's motive is just to delay the proceedings.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act

outcome.final_order: Case transferred to the Family Court, Ujjain.
